title: The Woodland Stalker Reimagined
body:
# **The Woodland Stalker Reimagined** 

![The Woodland Stalker Reimagined](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f8de1d760d0c6d213242a0193317f15e19d68358_0.webp)

## Creature That Should Never Have Existed...
Deep within ancient forests and endless underground caves lurks a mysterious and terrifying creature known as The Woodland Stalker.
It hunts in complete silence, waiting for the perfect moment to strike. During the night, its horrifying screams and heavy footsteps echo through the darkness, sending a warning to anyone unfortunate enough to hear them.
Once it has found its prey, escape becomes nearly impossible. Step by step, it closes the distance, driven only by the instinct to hunt. It will gnaw through bones, tear apart its victims, and leave nothing behind.
If you choose to explore dark forests or deep caves... remember one thing :
Light is your only hope.

## Features :
- Extremely Fast
- Climbs Walls
- Crawls Through One-Block Spaces
- Immortal
- Extremely Powerful
- Spawns in Dark Forests & Caves
- Terrifying Sounds
- Disturbing AI
- Creates an Intense Horror Atmosphere
## Requirements
- **GeckoLib** is required for this mod to function properly.
## Recommended Settings
For the best horror experience:

- Remove any Gamma or Night Vision mods.
- Set Brightness to Moody.
- Install Ambient Sounds.
- Install Sound Physics Remastered.
- Install Darkness Mods
- Use Shaders If Possible
- Avoid sleeping through the night.
- Explore Old Growth Pine Taiga forests after sunset.
## Upcoming Remake
Completely enhanced version of The Woodland Stalker Reimagined is currently in development.

Planned Improvements
- Higher-quality sound effects with brand-new audio.
- Smoother and more realistic animations.
- Improved textures with greater detail.
- A redesigned model that looks even more terrifying and distorted.
- Better AI and overall gameplay improvements.

Release Date: Coming Soon.
## Support

If you create a video featuring this mod, please include the download link in the description so others can easily find and download it.
